messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a change to the client->server capability exchange in v6. We need to decide the fallback contract and who owns the shim deployments.

sam: What exactly changes in the wire format?

maria: We add an optional `Client-Capabilities` header containing a JSON list (e.g. `["streaming", "kv-cache"]`). Older clients won't send it. Servers must behave as if minimal capabilities are present if header missing.

dong: My immediate thought: gateway shim that injects a safe default header for legacy clients so we don't break behavior. But who should own that shim — eng-platform (routing/infra) or eng-runtime (per-host adapter)?

jules: Platform should own the global shim rollout (canary/flags/telemetry). Runtime should own the adapter implementation and tests that handle `Client-Capabilities` interpretation. Separation of concerns: platform = deployment/feature-flag, runtime = runtime semantics.

sam: Ops concern: introducing an automatic injector can hide client regressions. We should make the shim opt-outtable per-tenant and emit clear telemetry (shim_injected true/false, original_client_version, detected_mismatch). Also add an explicit warning in logs. :eyes:

maria: Proposed phased plan: (1) implement shim behind feature-flag, default OFF, (2) canary to 5% of tenants + synthetic tests for 1 week, (3) enable for all tenants with opt-out, (4) deprecate shim after 6 months and remove. Telemetry events to emit: `shim_injected`, `shim_opt_out`, `client_header_present`, `client_version_guess`.

dong: Agreed. For detection, simple heuristic first: look for `Client-Capabilities` header, else sniff UA for known SDKs. Example pseudocode we plan to use in gateway shim:

```
if not req.headers.get('Client-Capabilities'):
  if re.match(r"redwood-sdk/\d+\.\d+", req.headers.get('User-Agent', '')):
    req.headers['Client-Capabilities'] = '["default"]'
  else:
    # leave missing, runtime will assume minimal capabilities
    pass
```

jules: Add a safety: if we inject, set `X-Shim-Injected: true` and `X-Shim-Reason: ua-sniff` so downstream services can see it. Also add a tenant-level flag `compat.fallback_shim=false` that can be toggled from Console.

sam: We should also surface a docs page with migration steps and an SDK patch that starts sending the header. Docs + SDK patch should be ready before canary.

maria: Owners & deadlines proposal: platform (jules) owns feature-flag/shim deployment and console opt-outs. Runtime (dong) owns adapter behavior, tests, and the `X-Shim-*` headers. Docs/SDK (sam + docs-team) ready a public guide and patch by next sprint. Can we aim for canary rollout in 14 days?

jules: I can take platform rollout owner. Will wire console flag + canary circuit. Targeting canary start in 14 days. :shipit:

dong: Runtime will deliver adapter + tests in 10 days, will include unit tests for missing headers and integration test that asserts `shim_injected` telemetry is emitted.

infra-bot: Deployment scheduled: `gateway/shim-injector` will be deployed to staging at 2026-05-12T02:00:00Z for canary tests.

sam: LGTM, thanks folks. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — I'll follow up with a short RFC note (summary + rollout checklist) and link to this thread.
